events.text_en: Kình Cốt Đường's whale crews bring their boats into Hồng Lô's cove and settle their families at Bồ Diệp Thôn.
Hồng Lô Cốc's furnace brews the wound pills for Thúy Vi's march on the Cold Ford, and its master takes no fee.
When the island coal dies in a blizzard, Tiết Thừa Hỏa goes down into the vent below the Cockscomb Mine to bring up fire, and does not come up.
Đồng Hồng Lô opens Hồng Lô's gate to Water roots, and the first elder writes the Snow Hearth Primer for them in one winter.
Băng Tâm Các buys away Hồng Lô's best student, Viên Chước, to brew outside its Array.
Viên Chước comes back to Hồng Lô to buy ash, and buys the head cook's son out of the kitchens.
